name: me.openbrowser/openbrowser-ai
description: AI browser automation with explicit MCP contexts and async Python control.

environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of allowed domains (empty for no restrictions)

environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_USER_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional explicit Chrome profile directory. Omit for an isolated profile per MCP server instance; concurrent owners of one explicit profile are rejected

environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_STORAGE_STATE
environmentVariables.description: Optional JSON file used as a one-time seed for cookies plus localStorage in managed MCP profiles; later updates are saved to the active profile copy

environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_COMPACT_DESCRIPTION
environmentVariables.description: Use minimal tool description (~500 tokens instead of ~1,430)

environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_MAX_OUTPUT
environmentVariables.description: Maximum output characters per code execution (default: 10000)

environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_MCP_MAX_CONTEXTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum open contexts total, including the legacy no-handle context (default: 16). Set a positive integer.

environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_MCP_START_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Browser startup bound in seconds for one MCP execution (default: 30).

environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_MCP_EXEC_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds before a tool call returns a structured timeout result (default: 110).

environmentVariables.name: OPENBROWSER_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Browser and context cleanup bound in seconds (default: 20).
